main_visual_task: A cold transparent sparkling-water bottle turns one falling citrus slice into a fast, joyful chain of material transformations, using four motivated internal shots rather than one continuous take.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same unlabeled transparent glass sparkling-water bottle, clear water, one fresh lime slice and silver bubbles
prompt_bible.environment_lock: sunlit cobalt-blue tabletop studio with one yellow back panel and no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real condensation, transparent water, lime pulp, glass, physically plausible bubbles and splash
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: hard warm sunlight from upper left with a fixed cool blue fill
prompt_bible.palette_lock: cobalt blue, lime green, lemon yellow, transparent silver highlights
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal commercial tabletop photography, crisp glass and condensation, controlled high-speed motion
prompt_bible.screen_direction: lime and liquid energy travel left-to-right across cuts; bottle label area remains blank
prompt_bible.audio_policy: four rhythmic diegetic accents: slice whoosh, glass tap, carbonation fizz, final splash; no voice

internal_shots.visual_state: a wet lime slice spins through a narrow shaft of sunlight above the blue table
internal_shots.subject_action: the lime crosses left-to-right and sheds three real droplets
internal_shots.camera_action: locked high-speed macro camera; the subject motion supplies the energy
internal_shots.lighting_state: hard warm rim on lime with cool blue fill
internal_shots.end_state: the lowest droplet reaches the right edge for an action match cut

camera_plan.motivation: let the first physical object establish direction and tempo
camera_plan.start_position: extreme macro level with the lime slice
camera_plan.path: camera remains locked beside the lime flight plane
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut exactly when the lowest droplet exits right

internal_shots.visual_state: the matched droplet lands on the chilled bottle shoulder and races through condensation
internal_shots.subject_action: the droplet hits, merges with beads and triggers a visible trail down the glass
internal_shots.camera_action: one short fast push-in toward the impact point, ending before the droplet exits
internal_shots.lighting_state: same upper-left sunlight, bottle refracts blue and yellow panels
internal_shots.end_state: droplet trail reaches the bottle liquid line and becomes a bright bubble stream

camera_plan.motivation: turn the action match into a tactile product reveal
camera_plan.start_position: close-up thirty centimeters from the bottle shoulder
camera_plan.path: push straight toward the droplet impact point and stop at the liquid line
camera_plan.speed_curve: fast start then sharp controlled deceleration
camera_plan.focus_transition: droplet impact to condensation trail to liquid line
camera_plan.end_position: extreme close-up at the bottle liquid line
camera_plan.axis_lock: optical axis stays centered on the moving droplet trail
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut when the trail transforms into the first bubble stream

internal_shots.visual_state: inside the same clear bottle, silver carbonation bubbles surge upward around the lime-green refracted edge
internal_shots.subject_action: small bubbles combine into a fast vertical stream, then burst through the surface
internal_shots.camera_action: one vertical tracking move rising with the bubble stream, then cut on the surface burst
internal_shots.focus: front bubble cluster and refracted lime color
internal_shots.lighting_state: sunlight becomes bright caustic patterns inside the real glass
internal_shots.end_state: the leading bubbles break the surface into a circular splash crown

camera_plan.motivation: enter the product and make carbonation feel physically enormous
camera_plan.start_position: macro level just below the bottle liquid line
camera_plan.path: track vertically upward with the leading bubble stream to the surface
camera_plan.speed_curve: accelerate with bubbles then stop at surface break
camera_plan.focus_transition: bubble cluster to surface membrane to splash edge
camera_plan.end_position: macro level with the liquid surface
camera_plan.stop_condition: cut on the instant the splash crown opens

internal_shots.visual_state: the circular splash becomes a real halo behind the same upright bottle on the blue table; lime slice rests at its base
internal_shots.subject_action: splash droplets fall naturally while condensation sparkles and carbonation remains visible
internal_shots.camera_action: one smooth pull back reveals the full bottle, lime and color panels, then exits on a clean hero composition
internal_shots.focus: full bottle silhouette and transparent liquid
internal_shots.lighting_state: same hard warm sun and cool fill, yellow panel now readable as color only
internal_shots.end_state: full unlabeled bottle centered, halo droplets still descending for the next edit

camera_plan.motivation: resolve the internal material journey into one readable product hero image
camera_plan.start_position: close to the splash halo behind the bottle shoulder
camera_plan.path: pull straight backward to a wide centered tabletop composition
camera_plan.speed_curve: smooth medium pullback with no artificial final hold
camera_plan.focus_transition: splash halo to full bottle and lime
camera_plan.stop_condition: exit on the last visible halo droplets, ready for an external cut

first_frame: extreme macro of one wet lime slice entering sunlight from the left
last_frame: wide hero composition of the same transparent bottle with a real splash halo and lime at its base
